result.title: Cadence Cuts Chip Verification From Weeks to Hours With AI Engineers and NVIDIA OpenShell
result.description:
See how @cadencedesignsystems and NVIDIA are transforming chip design verification with autonomous AI agents. In this demo, an engineer directs Cadence ChipStack to launch a secure RTL verification loop powered by Nemotron and secured by NVIDIA OpenShell. The system runs dynamic simulation and formal verification, identifies RTL bugs, fixes code, and escalates major design issues for human review. By automating one of the most time-consuming parts of chip development, Cadence helps reduce verification cycles from five weeks to less than a day, accelerating the design of the AI factories that power frontier AI.

result.title: Building the Future of Voice-First Sovereign AI: Sarvam & NVIDIA
result.description: Sarvam is partnering with NVIDIA to architect India’s sovereign AI infrastructure by utilizing NVIDIA’s full hardware and software stack. By training its foundational models from scratch on NVIDIA H100 GPU clusters using the NVIDIA NeMo framework and Megatron-LM, Sarvam is natively processing over 2 trillion authentic Indian language tokens. Leveraging open technologies like the NVIDIA Nemotron toolchains has enabled Sarvam to scale securely within national trust boundaries—effectively creating a high-performance, cost-efficient "UPI for AI" that brings population-scale intelligence to all 1.4 billion Indian citizens.
